Card Q&A.a: Yes. You must delete your own Digimon if you have a corresponding Digimon while your opponent doesn't.
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent doesn't have any level 3 or lower Digimon, do I have to delete my level 3 or lower Digimon for this card's effect?
If I use this card's effect to delete my level 3 Digimon with [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] in its name, can I then use this effect to play that deleted Digimon card from my trash without paying the cost?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 level 3 or lower Digimon. If this effect deleted one of your Digimon, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it gets +1000 DP.
